say:1:1310415001:0.text: I'm guessing you're quite an important person to be sharing the first dance with Her Highness.
say:1:1310415001:0.source_cn: 我猜您一定是位大人物，能和公主殿下一起跳第一支舞。
say:1:1310415001:0.male: I'm guessing you're quite an important person to be sharing the first dance with Her Highness.
say:1:1310415001:0.female: I'm guessing you're quite an important person to be sharing the first dance with Her Highness.

say:2:1310415002:0.text: Opening the ball at the festival is something ordinary folks can only dream about!
say:2:1310415002:0.source_cn: 能在祭典舞会里开舞的都是些了不得的人，这可是普通人盼都...
say:2:1310415002:0.male: Opening the ball at the festival is something ordinary folks can only dream about!
say:2:1310415002:0.female: Opening the ball at the festival is something ordinary folks can only dream about!

say:3:1310415003:0.text: Last year, it was a princess from the Lightbearer Empire. And before that... oh, I remember a Celestial graced us with their presence at the opening dance!
say:3:1310415003:0.source_cn: 去年的是耀光帝国一位亲王夫人，前年的是位来自莱希拉姆的...
say:3:1310415003:0.male: Last year, it was a princess from the Lightbearer Empire. And before that... oh, I remember a Celestial graced us with their presence at the opening dance!
say:3:1310415003:0.female: Last year, it was a princess from the Lightbearer Empire. And before that... oh, I remember a Celestial graced us with their presence at the opening dance!

say:4:1310415004:0.text: It's truly an honor to dance with you.
say:4:1310415004:0.source_cn: 能和您一起跳一支舞，真令我倍感荣耀啊。
say:4:1310415004:0.male: It's truly an honor to dance with you.
say:4:1310415004:0.female: It's truly an honor to dance with you.
